notes: SEQN is the unique participant identifier in NHANES, mapping to person_source_value to link all participant data.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight, stored as a numeric observation with a custom concept for the weight type.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight, stored similarly to WTDRD1 as a numeric observation.
Food/Individual component number is an ordinal identifier for food items within a recall, stored as a numeric observation.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating completeness/reliability; requires a custom concept for each status code.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer, stored as a string observation or linked to provider table if a provider concept exists.
Breast-fed infant indicator (binary) can be mapped to a standard Yes/No concept (e.g., 4188539 for Yes, 4188540 for No) or custom concept.
Number of days of intake is an ordinal count, stored as a numeric observation.
Number of days between intake and household interview is a continuous numeric variable, stored as a numeric observation.
Intake day of the week is categorical; could map to standard day-of-week concepts if available, otherwise custom concept.
Language used mostly is categorical; could map to standard language concepts (e.g., OMOP Vocabulary language concepts) or custom concept.
Combination food number is an ordinal identifier for combination food types, stored as a numeric observation.
Combination food type is a categorical description; stored as a string observation or mapped to a custom concept if codes exist.
Time of eating occasion (HH:MM) can be stored as a time or datetime observation; requires a reference date from the recall to form a complete datetime.
Name of eating occasion (e.g., breakfast, lunch) is categorical; could map to standard meal concepts (e.g., SNOMED) or custom concepts.

Source of food is a categorical variable describing where the food was obtained. It maps to observation with value_as_concept_id, but requires a custom concept or mapping to a standard concept for meal/snack source.
Binary indicator for whether meal was eaten at home. Could use concept_id 45878386 (Yes) or 45881666 (No) in value_as_concept_id, but exact concept depends on mapping.
USDA food code is an identifier for the food item. It can be stored as a string in observation or mapped to a standard concept for food, but no direct OMOP concept_id exists for USDA codes.
Grams of food consumed. This is a measurement of mass. Could use concept_id for 'Mass' (e.g., 8582) but requires unit concept_id for gram (8587).
Energy in kcal. Maps to measurement with concept_id 43060680 (Energy) and unit concept_id for kilocalorie (e.g., 9233).
Protein in grams. Maps to measurement with concept_id 3020891 (Protein intake) or similar nutrient concept, unit gram (8587).
Carbohydrate in grams. Maps to measurement with concept_id 3016721 (Carbohydrate intake) and unit gram.
Total sugars in grams. Maps to measurement with concept_id 3006102 (Sugars intake) and unit gram.
Dietary fiber in grams. Maps to measurement with concept_id 3019170 (Fiber intake) and unit gram.
Total fat in grams. Maps to measurement with concept_id 3021272 (Total fat intake) and unit gram.

Polyunsaturated fatty acids in grams. Maps to measurement with concept_id 3018336 (Polyunsaturated fat intake) and unit gram.
Cholesterol in mg. Maps to measurement with concept_id 3017120 (Cholesterol intake) and unit milligram (9655).
